topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I opened the email, expecting the usual, but there it was, my words staring back at me, polished and on display. It was my college application essay, an intimate dance of thoughts and fears, now published as an example. I felt the air grow a bit colder, the edges of the room sharper. I had poured myself into those sentences, each one a脆弱的桥梁，连接着过去的我和未来的希望。现在，它们被铺展在了无数陌生的目光下。我曾在那些文字中寻找自己的影子，但现在，它们似乎在嘲笑我的真诚。我关上了电脑，让房间笼罩在一种沉闷的静寂中。
